lede: What Vapi voice agents cost per minute with the default speech, AI and voice providers, plus the optional monthly packages.
calc_note: Per-minute range uses Vapi's default setup: Deepgram speech-to-text, OpenAI model, ElevenLabs voice and Vapi telephony. Other providers change the rate. The Pro package (10% of the hosting fee, $999/month minimum) is not included.
components_title: What goes into Vapi's per-minute price

compare.Pricing model: Pay as you go, per minute, optional monthly package
compare.Monthly platform fee: None, or $29 for the Core package

faq: Vapi charges a $0.05 per minute hosting fee plus the providers you choose, passed through at cost. With its default providers that comes to about $0.08 to $0.13 per minute. Monthly packages are optional: Core is $29/month.
You start with $5 in free credits and no monthly fee. After that you pay per minute.
What does the Core package add?
Core costs $29/month and raises you from 4 to 10 concurrent calls and from 1 to 5 included phone numbers, with email support on a 2 business day response time.
Does Vapi mark up model costs?
Vapi says provider and model costs are passed through with no markup. Its own charge is the $0.05 per minute hosting fee.
